portfolio_rationale: Soft June payrolls and downward revisions increase the odds of Fed easing before the July 31 exit, favoring rate-sensitive value, small caps, biotech, and defensive healthcare over stretched mega-cap tech, with bank earnings on July 14 as a concrete catalyst.
rationale_summary: Rotation portfolio tilted to value, healthcare, biotech, financials, and small-cap value on weakening labor data and near-term bank earnings catalysts, avoiding recently drawn-down tech/momentum.
